profile.reading:
This facility, recorded in OpenStreetMap under the name "STACK MILL2," is most plausibly STACK Infrastructure's MIL02 campus in the Milan, Italy metro area, a smaller, single-building site distinct from the three-building MIL01 campus documented elsewhere in this dataset. As with the related MILL1A/MILL1B records, STACK's own current site spells this campus's code as MIL02 (building MIL02A) rather than "MILL2," a discrepancy documented honestly here rather than silently corrected, since the exact-spelling match could not be independently confirmed this session. With that caveat, MIL02 is a 4.8-acre, single-building campus with 5.6 megawatts of IT capacity, and STACK's site states it sits "close to major highways" with a dedicated high-voltage substation, the same site-description language STACK uses for its larger MIL01 campus. Milan is STACK's largest single European market, with 11 campuses (MIL01 through MIL11) totaling 399 of the company's 743-megawatt EMEA footprint spanning 21 campuses across seven European countries, and STACK describes Milan as "Italy's economic capital" and one of "Europe's fastest-growing data center markets." STACK, headquartered in Denver, Colorado, reports roughly 8.5 gigawatts of capacity built or under development company-wide across 24 global markets. No comune-level address, building square footage, year of completion, or named power-grid connection is disclosed on STACK's public site for MIL02, and no independent Italian press coverage could be located this session because search-tool quota was exhausted. Tenant identities are not publicly disclosed, consistent with standard industry practice.

STACK's EMEA operations are led by a regional executive team including an interim chief executive, a chief financial officer, and a chief operating officer specific to the European business, reporting up to the company's group-wide board chairman, a structure that reflects the scale and relative maturity of STACK's European expansion, of which the Milan market, its largest in Europe by both campus count and capacity, forms a substantial part.
profile.research_note: This OSM record is named "STACK MILL2" -- most plausibly a variant transcription of STACK's own MIL02 campus code (a single-building, 4.8-acre, 5.6MW campus named MIL02A on STACK's site), but this was not independently confirmed against an exact-spelling source and is flagged as probable rather than certain, per the same naming-discrepancy caveat documented for the MILL1A/MILL1B records.
